task_summary: Redesigned LandingPage and LoginPage with a trendy, clean, minimal Linear/Vercel-inspired design aesthetic. Reduced LandingPage from 1,119 lines to ~230 lines of focused, high-contrast content (Navbar, Hero with subtle grid/glow, 3 authentic metrics, 4-pillar feature grid, 4-phase capstone workflow strip, 4-question FAQ accordion, dark CTA banner, and tokenized footer) while preserving idle chunk warmup and route prefetching. Transformed AuthLayout into a centered card layout eliminating bloated side panels and campus photography. Polished LoginPage copy and layout to 'Welcome back', right-aligned forgot password, and token-based link styling. Executed full 8-point Playwright visual audit across desktop/mobile viewports in light and dark themes with zero visual clipping or regressions.

metrics.auth_layout_redesign: Centered card with subtle grid/glow, 0 hardcoded photos
metrics.login_layout_redesign: Streamlined inputs, token links, clean single-card focus
